name: Basic Electrical
description: DC/AC circuits, Kirchhoff’s laws, network theorems, transformers, and 3-phase systems.

topics.name: DC Circuit Analysis
topics.description: KCL, KVL, nodal and mesh analysis

questions.prompt: Under Thevenin’s Theorem, any linear two-terminal DC network can be replaced by which equivalent circuit?
options: A single current source in parallel with a resistor
A single voltage source in series with a resistor
questions.explanation: Thevenin’s equivalent consists of an open-circuit voltage source (Vth) in series with an equivalent resistance (Rth).

questions.prompt: What happens to the power factor of an electrical load when capacitive correction is added to an inductive motor circuit?
options: Power factor moves closer to unity (1.0)
questions.explanation: Capacitors supply leading reactive power (VARs) that cancel lagging inductive reactive power, bringing power factor toward unity.
